bibliographic.title: Mom Guilt
bibliographic.author: Lindsay Slattery
bibliographic.description:
Mom Guilt is a Twine experience that tells the story of a single mom doing her best. I made it in part because the mom gamer community is HUGE and particularly supportive and wonderful. Plus, we all have one thing in common--being super behind on the games we want to play 😂 . I wanted to tell this story for that community, who don't often see themselves represented in games.

Like everything in motherhood, this game was built late at night post-work, post-dinner, post-bath time, post-bedtime, in a caffeine- and passion-fueled haze. It features multiple consequential choices and original artwork. I hope it resonates and brings light/ joy/ humor to your day.
